title: Andreessen Horowitz Backs Jev Maker at $7.5 Billion Value
summary: TypeSafe AI, the startup behind Jev, a new artificial intelligence model that went viral after it launched only a few weeks ago, has raised about $870 million at a $7.5 billion valuation in a financing led by Andreessen Horowitz.

title: Bearish Bond Narrative Has Gone Too Far, Deutsche Bank Says
summary: The swing to deeply-negative sentiment on fixed-income assets this year has gone too far, with the market underpricing the risk of an artificial-intelligence blowup that triggers a rush into bonds, according to Deutsche Bank AG’s George Saravelos.

title: AI Buildout is Boom 'Not Bubble,' Says Jared Gross
summary:
Credit markets are again becoming jittery over the prospects of more mega debt deals hitting a market already flush with financings to pay for the AI arms race.
Jared Gross, Head of Institutional Portfolio Strategy at JPMorgan Asset Management, discusses AI asset allocation and why he believes the AI buildout is indeed a boom, not a bubble. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: IA de código abierto impulsa material de abuso sexual infantil
summary: Una vez descargados los modelos, es casi imposible rastrear las actividades ilegales.

title: Panmure Warns AI Bubble Could Burst Within Next Two Years
summary: Joachim Klement, managing director and research analyst at Panmure Liberum, explains the risks the firm sees on Artificial Intelligence names and discusses the potential for a severe AI-triggered market crash. He speaks on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: EA Turns to Egan-Jones Rating as Angry Bondholders Claim Default
summary: Electronic Arts has told a group of creditors that it secured an investment-grade rating from Egan-Jones Ratings Co. for a subset of bonds, using the designation to counter claims that it owes them a premium after the video-game maker was taken private.

title: Musk’s SpaceX Acquiring Crucial Swath of Spectrum
summary: SpaceX is acquiring a crucial swath of spectrum from Grain Management. The new spectrum allows SpaceX to beam cell service to devices indoors from its Starlink network of satellites and will be combined with a terrestrial network to connect devices everywhere. Sana Pashankar reports on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: OpenAI Targets $70 Billion in Annualized Revenue by Year-End
summary: OpenAI is expecting to reach or exceed $70 billion in annualized revenue by the end of the year, driven largely by growth in its enterprise business. Ed Ludlow reports on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Koch Nets Nearly $1 Billion From Infor Payouts in Two Years
summary: A unit of Koch Inc. received a payout of almost $700 million from software firm Infor’s international business last year, according to a UK filing, taking the total dividend for the past two financial years to almost $1 billion.

title: Burnham Says UK Will Curb Non-Compete Clauses After Tech, AI Startup Outcry
summary: The UK is set to curb hiring restrictions that force employees to wait before moving jobs or starting companies, an issue that has drawn the ire of the nation’s technology startups.

title: Nvidia-Backed Lumentum Sold Out of AI Server Parts Till 2029
summary: Lumentum Holdings Inc.’s optical components are “completely sold out” through early 2029 on demand from tech companies clamoring for faster AI data centers, according to its chief executive officer.

title: Facebook Whistleblowers Don’t All Get the Hollywood Treatment
summary: The ‘Social Reckoning’ depicts one insider’s story while another lands in court

title: We Want to 'Dominate' US: Revolut's Storonsky
summary: Revolut CEO Nik Storonsky lays out the fintech’s ambitions to crack the US market and take on established players including JPMorgan and American Express. He says Revolut plans to build out a full digital banking offer, from credit cards to loans, while using AI and automation to reshape how customers bank. The company is also preparing to test AI agents that can shop and transact on behalf of users. He speaks to Tom Mackenzie at the Wave by Vento tech conference in Turin for the latest episode of Bloomberg Tech: Europe. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Medtech Faces One More Weak Quarter Before a 2027 Rebound
summary: Medical technology companies face one more subdued earnings quarter before heading into 2027 with their strongest growth outlook in more than two years, following a punishing stretch of policy uncertainty, cyberattacks and device recalls.

title: Bending Spoons CEO Sees Opportunity in ‘SaaSpocalypse’
summary: Bending Spoons CEO Luca Ferrari says falling software valuations are creating acquisition opportunities as AI reshapes the industry. He says the company is benefiting twice - from cheaper targets and from using AI to write code, improve products and scale its acquisition model faster. Bending Spoons says AI now writes at least 90% of its code. He speaks to Tom Mackenzie on the latest episode of "Bloomberg Tech: Europe" (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Revolut CEO Aims To Rival JPMorgan, American Express
summary:
Revolut CEO Nik Storonsky says he wants his fast-growing fintech to 'dominate' the US market and take on established players.
He speaks to Tom Mackenzie at the Wave by Vento tech conference in Turin for the latest episode of Bloomberg Tech: Europe (Source: Bloomberg)

title: China Is Trouncing the US in Consumer Adoption of Generative AI
summary: The US scores high on AI capability, but lags China in adoption.

title: Virgin Media Bonds Slide Deeper Into Distress on Snagged Deal
summary: Virgin Media O2’s bonds are slumping again on Friday, extending weeks of declines that have sent its notes to deeply distressed levels.

title: 'Last Night I Had Nightmares' Says Airtel Money CEO Before IPO
summary: Mobile payments firm Airtel Money starts trading on the London Stock Exchange on Friday, a listing that may mark the largest initial public offering for the bourse in five years. How the company trades will be the next test in London’s efforts to revitalize its capital markets. A strong first day would imply the city is fertile ground for IPOs and may encourage more companies to list on the LSE. At the same time, a debut that slips below the offer price would send a negative signal through the market, potentially deterring listing candidates. Airtel Money's CEO Ian Ferrao joined Caroline Heper and Charles Capel on Bloomberg Radio to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: OpenAI Expects $70 Billion in Annualized Revenue by End of 2026
summary: OpenAI is expecting to reach or exceed $70 billion in annualized revenue by the end of the year, according to people familiar with the matter, driven largely by growth in its enterprise business.
